subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3515
title: Provides that the training required to obtain certification as a public safety officer armed with a firearm must include two hours of training in nonlethal techniques for each hour of training in lethal techniques.
headline: HB 3515 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3515 was introduced in the House on February 6, 2025.
HB 3515 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
